% A document written for pdflatex that calls the expl3 copies of the
% pdfTeX primitives that are an error in DVI mode, such as
% \tex_pdfxform:D, as a package written in expl3 calls them. In the PDF
% each one writes into the PDF and puts nothing on the page, except the
% form and the colors. On the page the text around each one stays, and
% none of their arguments shows. They come in the preamble, in the body
% between \ExplSyntaxOn and \ExplSyntaxOff, in document commands with an
% expl3 body, in a copy that the preamble makes with \cs_new_eq:NN, in
% italic, sans-serif, and typewriter text, in a footnote, a theorem, a
% box, and a heading written to the table of contents. \tex_pdfxformname:D
% and \tex_pdfximagebbox:D are read in an \edef, and \tex_pdfxformname:D
% in a heading. The copies of the
% primitives that only warn in DVI mode stay primitives.
\pdfoutput=1
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\ExplSyntaxOn
\tex_pdfmapfile:D { +foo.map }
\tex_pdfmapline:D { =bar.pfb }
\tex_pdfnames:D { /Foo~[1~2] }
\tex_pdfobj:D { <<~/Preamble~1~>> }
\tex_pdffontattr:D \font { /Foo~1 }
\tex_pdfincludechars:D \font { abc }
\tex_pdfnobuiltintounicode:D \font
\tex_pdfinfo:D { /Title~(A~title) }
\tex_pdfcatalog:D { /PageMode~/UseNone }
\tex_pdfcompresslevel:D = 9
\cs_new_eq:NN \test_literal:w \tex_pdfliteral:D
\cs_new_protected:Npn \test_blue:n #1
    { \tex_pdfliteral:D { 0~0~1~rg } #1 \tex_pdfliteral:D { 0~g } }
\NewDocumentCommand \blue { m } { \test_blue:n {#1} }
\NewDocumentCommand \dblue { m }
    { \tex_pdfliteral:D ~ direct { 0~0~1~rg } #1 \tex_pdfliteral:D ~ direct { 0~g } }
\NewDocumentCommand \pblue { m }
    { \tex_pdfliteral:D ~ page { 0~0~1~rg } #1 \tex_pdfliteral:D ~ shipout { 0~g } }
\NewDocumentCommand \red { m }
    { \test_literal:w { 1~0~0~rg } #1 \test_literal:w { 0~g } }
\NewDocumentCommand \turn { m }
    {
        \tex_pdfsave:D \tex_pdfsetmatrix:D { 0~1~-1~0 }
        \rlap {#1} \tex_pdfrestore:D \phantom {#1}
    }
\NewDocumentCommand \isprim { m }
    { #1 ~ \exp_args:Nc \token_if_primitive:NTF { tex_pdf #1 :D } { primitive } { redefined } }
\ExplSyntaxOff
\begin{document}
\tableofcontents

\section{Head \blue{x} end}

Details: before \ExplSyntaxOn \setbox2\hbox{x} \tex_pdfxform:D 2 \ExplSyntaxOff after.

\setbox2\hbox{form}%
Form: before\ExplSyntaxOn \tex_pdfxform:D attr {/X~1} resources {/Y~2} 2
\tex_pdfrefxform:D \tex_pdflastxform:D \ExplSyntaxOff{} after.

\ExplSyntaxOn
\edef \formedef { \tex_pdfxformname:D \tex_pdflastxform:D }
\ExplSyntaxOff
Name: [\formedef] end.

\ExplSyntaxOn
\section{Name~[\tex_pdfxformname:D \tex_pdflastxform:D]~end}
\ExplSyntaxOff

Meaning: \texttt{\meaning\formedef} end.

Literal: before \blue{one} after.

Italic: \emph{before \dblue{two} after}.

Sans: \textsf{before \blue{three} after}.

Typewriter: \texttt{before \pblue{four} after}.

Copy: before \red{five} after.

Footnote: before\footnote{Note \blue{six} end.} after.

\begin{theorem}
Theorem \dblue{seven} end.
\end{theorem}

Box: \sbox0{\blue{boxed}}\usebox0{} after.

Matrix: before \turn{turned}{} after.

Stack: before\ExplSyntaxOn \tex_pdfcolorstack:D 0~push {0~0~1~rg} pushed
\tex_pdfcolorstack:D 0~pop \ExplSyntaxOff{} after.

Link: before\ExplSyntaxOn \tex_pdfstartlink:D user {/Subtype~/Link} linked
\tex_pdfrunninglinkoff:D \tex_pdfrunninglinkon:D \tex_pdfendlink:D \ExplSyntaxOff{} after.

Image: before\ExplSyntaxOn \tex_pdfximage:D width~1cm {test-picture.png}
\tex_pdfrefximage:D \tex_pdflastximage:D \ExplSyntaxOff{} after.

\ExplSyntaxOn
\tex_pdfximage:D {test-picture.png}
\edef \bboxedef { \tex_pdfximagebbox:D \tex_pdflastximage:D 1 }
\ExplSyntaxOff
Bbox: [\bboxedef] end.

Objects: before\ExplSyntaxOn \tex_pdfobj:D reserveobjnum
\tex_pdfobj:D stream~attr {/X~1} {<<~/Y~2~>>} \tex_pdfrefobj:D \tex_pdflastobj:D \ExplSyntaxOff{} after.

Use: before\ExplSyntaxOn \tex_pdfobj:D reserveobjnum
\int_set:Nn \l_tmpa_int { \tex_pdflastobj:D }
\tex_immediate:D \tex_pdfobj:D useobjnum \l_tmpa_int {<<~/Y~2~>>}
\tex_pdfrefobj:D \l_tmpa_int \ExplSyntaxOff{} after.

Annotation: before\ExplSyntaxOn \tex_pdfannot:D width~1cm {/Subtype~/Text} \ExplSyntaxOff{} after.

Destination: before\ExplSyntaxOn \tex_pdfdest:D name {here} fit \ExplSyntaxOff{} after.

Outline: before\ExplSyntaxOn \tex_pdfoutline:D goto~name {here} count~0 {Outline~title}
\ExplSyntaxOff{} after.

Thread: before\ExplSyntaxOn \tex_pdfthread:D name {t} \ExplSyntaxOff{} after.

Spaces: before\ExplSyntaxOn \tex_pdfinterwordspaceon:D \tex_pdffakespace:D
\tex_pdfinterwordspaceoff:D \ExplSyntaxOff{} after.

First.

\ExplSyntaxOn \tex_pdfliteral:D {0~g} \ExplSyntaxOff

\ExplSyntaxOn \tex_pdfrefximage:D \tex_pdflastximage:D \ExplSyntaxOff

Second.

\ExplSyntaxOn \tex_pdfstartthread:D name {u} \ExplSyntaxOff
Started thread.\par
\ExplSyntaxOn \tex_pdfendthread:D \ExplSyntaxOff

Guards: \isprim{info}, \isprim{catalog}, \isprim{trailer},
\isprim{compresslevel}, \isprim{minorversion}, \isprim{lastxform},
\isprim{lastximage}, \isprim{lastobj}, \isprim{colorstackinit},
\isprim{trailerid}, \isprim{pageattr}, \isprim{pagesattr},
\isprim{pageresources}, \isprim{gentounicode}, \isprim{glyphtounicode}.

\end{document}
